summary: Call for Papers The Pervasive Agentic Systems and Multimodal Foundation Models (PerAgent) workshop focuses on the critical systems-level challenges of transitioning from narrow, singletask edge AI to general-purpose, autonomous AI agents operating in physical environments. Currently, foundation models are trapped in the cloud due to massive computational requirements. This workshop explores how large-scale models such as Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and Multimodal Language Models (MLMs) can be compressed, decentralized, and securely integrated with pervasive sensor networks.
title: Call for papers
